title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-05
source: center lodge, mics mounted on rails->Sony cassette audience master-> analog cassette XL II, no dolby->Sony TC D5M DAT->playback on Sony PCM R-700-> HDD via za2->CDR master via CD Architect->EAC->SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a stellar Port Chester show highlighted by an Other One > Dark Star > St. Stephen run.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this 1970 audience tape, calling it far superior to many later soundboard releases and praising its clarity despite the inherent hiss of a crowd source. The performance shines especially in the second‑set suite of Other One into Dark Star and St. Stephen, which reviewers cite as the high point of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars), highlighting both an outstanding performance and surprisingly good audio quality for a non‑soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with some hiss, but unusually clear and well‑balanced; reviewers note it sounds better than many 1980s soundboard releases.

standout_songs: Other One > Dark Star > St. Stephen
show_quality.setlist_flow: Port Chester shows are praised as a class of their own; the highlighted sequence provides a strong, flowing second‑set climax.
